description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain known for by-the-slice and whole-pie sales with any toppings, available for in-store pickup or delivery. The Vancouver location sits at level 0 with indoor seating and no drive-through. The chain also offers a gluten-free cauliflower crust, making it a flexible quick-stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

The nutritional info subpage explicitly lists a 'Gluten Free Cauliflower' crust and multiple veggie toppings, confirming GF and vegetarian options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
